module.name: aws_eks_cluster_install_tmm_nads
module.description: Creates the two AWS-specific NetworkAttachmentDefinitions (ens7-ipvlan-l2 external, ens8-ipvlan-l2 internal) TMM uses on its data-plane secondary ENIs. Discovers the matching f5-bnk-role-tagged subnets at apply time to derive each NAD's static IPAM placeholder. Depends on eks-cluster-install-multus (cloud-agnostic, vendored from bnk-forge-catalog-shared) for the actual Multus CNI install. Runs between eks-cluster-install-multus and eks-cluster-cneinstall in the -with-hp-nodes variant blueprints.

required.reason: Provides the kubeconfig context for kubectl applies and the vpc_id used to scope tag-discovery. Auto-wired via Forge's local.forge_kubeconfig injection + vpc_id from_module wiring.
Must run first — Multus must be installed and the NetworkAttachmentDefinition CRD Established before this module applies NAD CRs. multus_ready gate auto-wires from this module's output.

optional.reason: Alternative upstream — emits the same kubeconfig + vpc_id outputs.
Logical predecessor — HP-nodes attaches the ens7/ens8 secondary ENIs that these NADs bind to AND creates the tagged TMM subnets this module discovers. Wire as depends_on in the blueprint.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time (any auth method).

required.name: vpc_id
required.description: Cluster VPC ID. Scopes the f5-bnk-role tag-discovery used to derive each NAD's static-address placeholder. Auto-wired from cluster-register / cluster-create.

required.name: multus_ready
required.description: Gate from eks-cluster-install-multus. tmm-nads asserts this is true before applying NAD CRs. Auto-wired in variant blueprints from install-multus.multus_ready.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

optional.name: nad_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the NADs are created. MUST match the CNEInstance namespace (the CNE reconciler resolves NADs by name within it). Gold-standard split: f5-cne-system.

optional.name: nad_external_name
optional.description: External NAD name. Must match cneinstall's network_attachments[0].

optional.name: nad_external_master
optional.description: Host interface for the external NAD. Default 'ens7' matches hp-nodes external_eni_device_index=2.

optional.name: nad_internal_name
optional.description: Internal NAD name. Must match cneinstall's network_attachments[1].

optional.name: nad_internal_master
optional.description: Host interface for the internal NAD. Default 'ens8' matches hp-nodes internal_eni_device_index=3.

optional.name: nad_cni_type
optional.description: Multus CNI plug-in. F5 reference uses 'ipvlan'; on-prem may use 'host-device' or 'macvlan'.

optional.name: nad_ipvlan_mode
optional.description: ipvlan mode. Only used when nad_cni_type = ipvlan.

optional.name: nad_external_static_address
optional.description: Explicit override for the external NAD's static-address placeholder. Empty = derive from the first f5-bnk-role=tmm-external subnet discovered in vpc_id (cidrhost(cidr, 1) + matching prefix).

optional.name: nad_internal_static_address
optional.description: Explicit override for the internal NAD's static-address placeholder. Empty = derive from the first f5-bnk-role=tmm-internal subnet discovered in vpc_id.

optional.name: nad_static_address_fallback
optional.description: Used only when discovery returns no tagged subnets AND no per-NAD override is set. Default 10.10.1.1/24 matches the F5 install guide's reference value.

key_outputs.name: nad_external_static_address
key_outputs.description: Resolved static-address placeholder used in the external NAD's ipam stanza (override, derived, or fallback).

key_outputs.name: nad_internal_static_address
key_outputs.description: Resolved static-address placeholder used in the internal NAD's ipam stanza.

key_outputs.name: discovered_tmm_external_cidrs
key_outputs.description: TMM-external subnet CIDRs the module discovered via the f5-bnk-role=tmm-external tag in vpc_id.

key_outputs.name: discovered_tmm_internal_cidrs
key_outputs.description: TMM-internal subnet CIDRs the module discovered via the f5-bnk-role=tmm-internal tag in vpc_id.

key_outputs.name: nads_applied
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once both NADs are applied. cneinstall depends on this before rendering the CNEInstance CR.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (STS / SSO / assumed-role only).
